basic_info.description: Elegant and light-filled 2BR/2BA Edwardian flat in coveted Dolores Heights/Castro location, just one block from the iconic Dolores Park. This beautifully updated 1,161 sqft home blends timeless period charm with modern conveniences. Classic details include rich wood floors, wainscoting, tall coved ceilings with picture rails, pocket doors, and elegant moldings. The flexible layout offers comfortable living and entertaining space, filled with natural light. The spacious south-facing main bedroom features a charming period fireplace with a gas insert, working parlor doors, and abundant natural light. The remodeled and generously sized kitchen features marble countertops, high-end stainless steel appliances, and generous cabinetry. Both bathrooms are thoughtfully updated with stylish, contemporary finishes. In-unit washer/dryer adds everyday convenience. Enjoy sweeping, unobstructed views from Corona Heights to Downtown SF, the Bay Bridge, and East Bay - truly breathtaking! Located on a quiet, tree-lined, and secluded block, yet moments to the Castro, the Mission, transit, shops, and restaurants. A rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history, updated for modern living.
